_meta.method: per ELEMENT. key = (screen gate, aligned element, property). Alignment is an LCS over element signatures; `style` is excluded from the signature so a restyled element still aligns with itself.
_meta.supersedes: docs/fidelity/bundle-geometry-diff.json, which keyed on a sorted multiset of literal values per (screen, property) and therefore could not see a moved element (D251).

n8_full_pass.method: every changed entry on all 17 screens, read against the v7 and v8 markup AND against our components. Confidence comes from `pass`: a pass-1 pair matched on the STRONG key (tag, attributes, own text and every non-measured declaration) and is the same element beyond reasonable doubt; a pass-2 pair on a BARE div matched on `div|||` — literally no identity — so it pairs by position among leftovers and is not evidence of anything.

n8_full_pass.the_breadcrumb: v8 REMOVES the in-page breadcrumb from every screen — `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:Npx;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut…)">`. It accounts for 16 of the 82 bare changed declarations across 5 element pairs, and for the `removed` on dash, results, send and tasks. It is ALREADY CORRECT for us: F3 moved the breadcrumb into the shell (lib/shell/crumbs.ts), so the page holds no copy. Every one of the 16 is a mispair created by the removal, not a restyle.
n8_full_pass.verdict: ZERO additional geometry to build. N6 read 11 named elements and that WAS the complete set of real changes; the remaining 101 declarations are 16 breadcrumb removals, 59 position-only pairings with no identity, 7 already-correct and 19 on elements we never built.
